status: Stored observations summarized; no verification or selection performed

authority_as_recorded.scope: Develop spatially braced CFRP tripod/quadpod alternatives and retain larger-section unbraced comparisons. No component, dimension, spine count, landing-gear arrangement, procurement or review baseline is selected.

frame_as_recorded.CAD_axes: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up; nominal foot plane Z=0
frame_as_recorded.eventual_CAD_to_body_position_m: 0.001*R_BC*(p_CAD_mm-CG_C0_mm); CG_C0 is not the partial tube CG

other_changes: Save native and STEP before SVG rendering
Replace edge renderer with diagnostic renderer and explicit fallback/omission reporting
Add drawing diagnostics to candidate files and manifest

api_research.units: CAD coordinates and lengths in mm; curve parameters use the edge parameterization
api_research.finding: Upstream wrapper exposes these interfaces. Installed-version compatibility must be observed during execution.
api_research.limitation: Mutable upstream main was inspected; no claim that it is the installed implementation or diagnoses the failed edge.

generator_revision_provenance.evidence_boundary: Generation and diagnostic observations only; not verification, vehicle selection or review acceptance.

source_scope: Eight exploratory native tube-component candidates. Actual solids measured; fittings, load paths and equipment incomplete. No automatic down-selection.
limitations: No FCStd or STEP file is reopened by this program.
Validity, editability and clearance values are reported by the CAD generator, not independently verified here.
Tube sums exclude fittings, ring, gimbal, equipment and other installed items; they are not complete vehicle mass or CG.
Overlapping tube components are not accepted joints or corrected assembled mass.
Rotor slabs, yoke capsules and joint spheres are assumed non-mass reference envelopes.
Distance observations are sampled, not continuous or loaded clearance certification.
Drawing omissions remain unresolved; SVG production alone is not a complete drawing.
All original null acceptance fields are retained; no PDR/CDR or physical acceptance is inferred.
